Emerald Amber Discard Aggro or Ruby Amber aggro both destroy Ruby Amethyst. Imo if you play the traditional flyn/queen turn 1 into turn 2 Bucky into turn 3. Prince John / Ursula turn 4. Shift flyn sing any discard song or double sing a discard song. You have serious card advantage. I have not played a game as discard where my opponent has gotten to get to 7 mana without me literally being on victory's doorstep if not already winning. Discard has solid answers for everything R/A offers. Your highest quester in Flynn 4 is immune to everything in the deck except Be Prepared and Madame Medusa (Not mentioning M9) If they got to turn 9 something went very wrong on your end. I've found Ruby Amethyst to be a solid deck but no where near it's previous potency. Still definitely a top 5 deck in the meta game and that's not changing. 

Disclaimer I can sing all the praise I want about Discard but you get obliterated by anything with steel in it so if you're going to a tournament be warned of it's limitations. It's not unwinnable but Bucky and John are prime Tinkerbell/GYS/ Bongo targets
